os-25-22.alt: Ball-and-stick models of three molecules, with nitrogen atoms in blue, carbon in black, oxygen in red and hydrogen in white. Left, labeled ammonia: one nitrogen bonded to three hydrogens. Middle, labeled urea: a central carbon double-bonded to an oxygen and bonded to two nitrogens, each carrying two hydrogens. Right, labeled uric acid, much larger: two fused rings of carbon and nitrogen atoms, a six-membered ring and a five-membered ring, with three oxygens and four hydrogens attached around the edge.
